prompt_en: Create the requested scene with the specified subjects, composition, materials and lighting. Preserve all requested counts and exact on-image wording.
prompt_cn: 根据要求创作新画面，明确主体、构图、材质与光照，保留指定数量及画面文字原文。

prompt_en: Make the requested change to the specified object in the first image. Match its shadows and perspective to the scene, preserving everything outside the requested change.
prompt_cn: 修改第一张图中指定对象的指定属性，使阴影与透视符合场景，保留其他内容。
seed_terms: 局部修改|属性|保留原图

prompt_en: Remove the specified object from the first image and continue the exposed background coherently. Preserve all remaining subjects, composition, lighting and text.
prompt_cn: 移除第一张图中指定对象，合理延续其后方露出的背景，保留其他主体、构图、光照与文字。

prompt_en: Apply the requested object or appearance from the second image to its specified target in the first image. Preserve its exact reference details and the first image's remaining content.
prompt_cn: 将第二张图中指定对象或外观应用到第一张图的指定目标，保留参考细节和第一张图的其他内容。

prompt_en: Replace only the specified lettering with the exact user-provided wording, in its original language. Match the placement, typography and perspective, preserving all other content.
prompt_cn: 仅将指定文字替换为用户提供的原文，保持其语言，并匹配位置、字体与透视，保留其他内容。
